nav.label: Account setup steps
nav.title: Account setup
nav.note: Needed once for every role on your account.
nav.footnote: Step 2 is skipped when you already picked where to start.

title: Before you start
lead: These details belong to your SimpleFit account, not to a role profile. You give them once — every role you set up later uses the same account.

loadFailure.title: We couldn’t load your account.
loadFailure.body: Check your connection and try again.

failure.title: We couldn’t save your details.
failure.body: Check your connection. Nothing you entered is lost.

dateOfBirth.label: Date of birth
dateOfBirth.help: 16 or older · can’t be changed once you continue.

agreements.label: Agreements
agreements.terms: I accept the Terms of Service
agreements.news: Send me product news by email
agreements.newsFootnote: Product news is never required. Change it any time in settings.
agreements.newVersion: A new version is in force: accept it to continue.

fullName.title: Full name
fullName.body: The name on your account. Role profiles choose their own display name later.

dateOfBirth.title: Date of birth
dateOfBirth.body: Confirms you’re 16 or older. Private — never shown to others.

consents.title: Terms & Privacy
consents.body: We record which version you accepted and when.

next.title: What happens next
next.body: Picked where to start before signing in? We take you straight there. Otherwise you choose next.
next.note: Nothing here picks a role. Signing in with Google or Apple doesn’t either.

errors.tooYoung: You must be 16 or older to use SimpleFit.
errors.invalidDate: Enter a real date, not in the future.
errors.immutable: Your date of birth can’t be changed anymore.
errors.terms: Accept the Terms of Service to continue.
errors.privacy: Accept the Privacy Policy to continue.
